long_biography.plain_text:
Groupe BAM grew out of a meeting between Serge Marrant and construction specialist Laurent Bauer. The two established a group in 2010 and began bringing established regional building companies together. Its work expanded beyond timber framing and roofing to encompass concrete, metalwork, major building projects and the renovation of existing sites. Marrant remained at the head of the group as it added further specialist firms in western and southern France.

The acquisition model gives the companies shared backing while preserving their local names, teams and technical expertise. BAM's construction businesses work across prefabrication and on-site building, so projects can draw on several trades within the group. Marrant's holding-company roles connect him to those operations, and he continues to be identified as the group's president. The result is a network of regional specialists under a common construction platform.
